words.prose: {{ar:يَحْسَبُ}} ({{tr:yaḥsabu}}) opens the ayah by moving from the prior acts of collecting and counting into an inner diagnosis. Its 3ms imperfect form carries the same man from 104:2 without renaming him, so the reader feels the hoarder pass directly from external accumulation into habitual reckoning. The verb does not take {{ar:مَالَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:mālahū}}) as a simple object; it governs the whole {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) proposition, making the error a complete claim about wealth causing permanence. The root's counting and supposing ranges converge here: counted wealth becomes a false calculation, and the sufficiency branch sharpens the mistake because wealth is treated as what will be enough against death. The bare imperfect keeps this as an ongoing state, while the embedded perfect {{ar:أَخْلَدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:akhladahū}}) presents the imagined result as already accomplished. The accepted {{ar:يَحْسِبُ}} ({{tr:yaḥsibu}}) vowel variant changes the medial sound color while the ḥāʾ-and-sīn texture remains breathy and tight, so the recitational variation does not loosen the misreckoning frame. Against the true permanence language cited at 76:19, the same broad permanence field is inverted here into a wealth-based estimate rather than an actual enduring state.

The heavy, geminated form also blocks a light {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) reparse and keeps a closed noun-clause architecture: wealth as subject, immortalizing predicate, no outside agent entering the imagined causal chamber.

words.prose: {{ar:مَالَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:mālahū}}) is not just the thing he thinks about. Because {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) governs it as the embedded subject, and because {{ar:أَخْلَدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:akhladahū}}) supplies the predicate, wealth becomes the imagined actor inside the false claim. The same root had appeared in 104:2 as indefinite wealth gathered; here it returns as possessed, definite {{ar:مَالَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:mālahū}}), a consolidated mass marked as his before it is imagined to act on him. The repeated {{ar:ـهُ}} ({{tr:-hū}}) then becomes crucial: first it marks ownership in {{ar:مَالَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:mālahū}}), then it marks the owner as object in {{ar:أَخْلَدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:akhladahū}}). That suffix loop makes the reversal visible and audible: what he owns is grammatically staged as what secures, and traps, him. The nasal handoff from the heavy particle into the wealth noun also makes the governor-to-ism bond audible before the final suffix cadence closes the loop. The concrete wealth range keeps the delusion material, while the inclining association can be retained only as a narrowed pressure: he leans toward wealth so deeply that the clause imagines it leaning back with causal power. The recurrence at 111:2, where wealth does not avail, makes the local confidence look even more exposed, and the garden-owner wealth-superiority claim at 18:34 adds a secondary parallel for wealth-confidence without displacing the local wealth-as-agent grammar.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: ongoing supposition enclosing a completed causative claim

words.prose: {{ar:أَخْلَدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:akhladahū}}) is the ayah's landing word, and it makes the false claim syntactically complete. The Form IV causative does not merely say that the man remains; it casts {{ar:مَالَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:mālahū}}) as the agent that has made him permanent, while the attached {{ar:ـهُ}} ({{tr:-hū}}) makes the owner the affected object. That is the central reversal: the possessed thing becomes the imagined cause, and the possessor becomes what it acts upon. The perfect form treats this impossible result as already done, even though the whole claim remains inside the ongoing {{ar:يَحْسَبُ}} ({{tr:yaḥsabu}}). The finite verbal shape is therefore marked: eternity is cast as an event that wealth has supposedly performed, not as ordinary participial eternity language. The selected form also differs from simple remaining or intensive perpetuation; it frames a single caused state attributed to wealth. The 7:176 frame {{ar:أَخْلَدَ إِلَى}} ({{tr:akhlada ilā}}) can shadow the word as an earthward-clinging contrast, but the missing {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) and the direct object here keep the local sense narrowed to causative immortalizing. The broader root field of eternity, settled inward thought, and remaining behind deepens the irony without replacing the grammar. Final position lets the reader exit on the claimed permanence that 104:4 will reject with {{ar:كَلَّا}} ({{tr:kallā}}), turning imagined security into impending expulsion.

topics.headline: wealth is made the cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Form IV verb makes wealth the imagined agent that causes permanence, not merely an object associated with permanence.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:أَخْلَدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:akhladahū}}) as a Form IV perfect causative, and attachment evidence identifies {{ar:مَالَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:mālahū}}) as its subject.

topics.headline: the owner receives the action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the suffix on {{ar:أَخْلَدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:akhladahū}}) turns the possessor into the object acted on by his possession.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final {{ar:ـهُ}} ({{tr:-hū}}) as the direct object of {{ar:أَخْلَدَ}} ({{tr:akhlada}}), referring to the same owner marked in {{ar:مَالَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:mālahū}}).

topics.headline: clinging contrast is compressed, not governing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast with {{ar:أَخْلَدَ إِلَى}} ({{tr:akhlada ilā}}) at 7:176, while the local direct object keeps this as a causative claim imposed on the owner.
topics.reason: V4 supports the {{ar:أَخْلَدَ إِلَى}} ({{tr:akhlada ilā}}) clinging frame, but the local word lacks {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) and takes a direct object suffix, so the echo is narrowed to contrast rather than local valency.

topics.headline: the impossible result is treated as done
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that an ongoing supposition continually asserts a completed immortalization.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:أَخْلَدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:akhladahū}}) as perfect, while {{ar:يَحْسَبُ}} ({{tr:yaḥsabu}}) is imperfect and governs the entire claim.

topics.headline: permanence is shadowed by earthward attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word's permanence claim is shadowed by the 7:176 earthward-clinging frame, undercutting the fantasy of transcendence.
topics.reason: The clinging frame is a valid lexical contrast for the same Form IV root, but local direct-object grammar selects the causative immortalizing claim as the near sense.

topics.headline: the root field darkens permanence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that eternity, settled inward thought, and remaining-behind pressures make the claimed permanence feel like confinement rather than triumph.
topics.reason: V4 includes permanence, inward thought, and clinging or remaining fields for {{ar:خ ل د}} ({{tr:kh-l-d}}); these remain lexical pressures, not replacements for the local Form IV direct-object sense.

topics.headline: eternity becomes an event claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that permanence is cast as a finite caused event attributed to wealth, not as ordinary participial eternity language.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks this exact form as low-occurrence, and the CRITICAL distribution contrasts it with more common nominal or participial eternity forms.

topics.headline: single causation, not intensive perpetuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the selected form frames wealth as causing a state, not simply describing remaining or intensively perpetuating.
topics.reason: The local form is {{ar:أَخْلَدَ}} ({{tr:akhlada}}) with object suffix, not simple {{ar:خَلَدَ}} ({{tr:khalada}}) or intensive {{ar:خَلَّدَ}} ({{tr:khallada}}).

topics.reason: {{ar:أَخْلَدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:akhladahū}}) supplies the embedded predicate and closes 104:3, while the next ayah's opening rejection answers the claim.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated final {{ar:ـهُ}} ({{tr:-hū}}) binds owner and wealth, while the heavier consonants give the closing permanence claim weight.
topics.reason: Both {{ar:مَالَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:mālahū}}) and {{ar:أَخْلَدَهُۥ}} ({{tr:akhladahū}}) carry final {{ar:ـهُ}} ({{tr:-hū}}), while the final word supplies the ayah's closing stem.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cognition at word 1 takes the possessed wealth at word 3 as the cause expressed by the causative permanence verb at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: A supposition transfers causal power from the possessor to his possession: accumulated property is imagined to manufacture an enduring state for him.

activation_trace.role: The supposition branch supplies the uncertain mental judgment that launches the causal claim.
The acquiring-and-having branch supplies the possessed stock that is promoted into an agent.
The enduring-state branch supplies the imagined result, while the causative form assigns its production to wealth.

changed_reading.before: He thinks his wealth has made him immortal.
changed_reading.after: He performs a causal misattribution in which possessed stock is treated as a machine for producing duration in its possessor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reckoning verb at word 1, the countable possession at word 3, and the duration predicate at word 4 form a quantity-to-time sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same mental operation that totals property silently extrapolates the total into lifespan: measurable abundance is mistaken for an increase in duration.

activation_trace.role: The counting-and-accounting branch supplies the quantitative operation behind the judgment.
The wealth branch supplies an inventory capable of being totaled and increased.
The long-lasting-state branch supplies the temporal quantity onto which the property total is projected.

changed_reading.before: Wealth vaguely gives him confidence that he will last.
changed_reading.after: He reads life as a balance sheet, converting a rising property total into an imagined extension of personal time.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A support image latent at word 1 can act through the possessive noun at word 3 upon the staying-and-clinging range of word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wealth is imagined as enoughness made material: a cushion or prop on which the subject can settle, remain attached, and resist displacement.

activation_trace.role: The sufficiency branch supplies the belief that wealth is enough to answer vulnerability.
The cushioning branch physicalizes that sufficiency as something that props or seats the subject.
The property branch supplies the material converted into the imagined support.
The leaning-and-clinging branch turns permanence into settled attachment rather than abstract endlessness.

changed_reading.before: He expects wealth to grant abstract immortality.
changed_reading.after: He imagines wealth as a sufficient physical and social prop on which he can settle and become immovable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cognition at word 1 can reckon wealth among grounds of standing, while word 4 can image something enduringly fixed upon a person.
baseline_models.mechanism: Possession is converted into visible merit; the subject mistakes an attached badge of rank for a status that cannot decay.

activation_trace.role: The counted-merit branch supplies social worth, including wealth, as a basis of rank.
The possession branch supplies the visible resource from which rank is inferred.
The body-fixed adornment branch supplies the image of status worn as a lasting insignia.

changed_reading.before: He expects biological survival from wealth.
changed_reading.after: He may also mistake wealth-marked prestige, fixed to him like an insignia, for an undying social self.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sentence begins with an uncertain judgment at word 1 and ends with a root whose inventory includes a thought settled inwardly at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The predicate can echo back into the cognition: wealth not only appears to prolong the subject but makes the prolongation-belief lodge and persist inside him.

activation_trace.role: The supposition branch supplies the proposition whose persistence is at issue.
The wealth branch supplies both the proposition's object and the force that repeatedly confirms it.
The inwardly settled-thought branch relocates permanence from lifespan to the durability of the conviction itself.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a mistaken belief about external longevity.
changed_reading.after: It can simultaneously diagnose wealth as having made the longevity-belief itself settle and persist within the subject.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding portrait turns fixed wealth-status into a repeated comparative practice: comprehensive faulting and social pressure lower others so the subject's own rank can feel permanent.

activation_trace.role: The counted-merit branch anchors the changed reading in wealth-based social standing.
The wealth branch supplies the comparative resource whose prestige is being defended.
The fixed-adornment branch lets prestige appear attached to the subject as a durable badge.
The encompassing-whole branch makes the social practice comprehensive rather than occasional.
The branch of attacking people's defects supplies one means of producing downward comparison.
The faulting branch doubles the mechanism and makes disparagement look habitual.

structural_cues: The totalizing modifier and paired agent nouns precede the accumulation and belief sequence.
The two neighboring faulting expressions make social aggression a repeated profile rather than an isolated remark.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comprehensive, repeated faulting plus wealth-based merit; I infer that lowering others is a maintenance mechanism for seemingly durable rank. A live alternative is that the first ayah only identifies the subject's conduct and does not explain his longevity belief.

changed_reading.before: Wealth appears to promise either life or static prestige.
changed_reading.after: He makes wealth feel socially immortal by continually depressing others' standing beneath his own.

context_deltas.mechanism: Physical pressure and pushing images activate the focus's remote cushioning branch: wealth becomes an impact-absorbing buffer that lets the subject press others while imagining himself impossible to dislodge.

activation_trace.role: The cushioning branch supplies the buffer that absorbs pressure and props the subject in place.
The settled-clinging branch converts immortality into resistance to displacement.
The squeezing branch supplies an external force against which the imagined wealth-buffer operates.
The prodding branch turns social harm into force that moves another body.
The pushing branch reinforces a force-field reading of domination and resistance.

structural_cues: The paired actor nouns permit their verbal aggression to be heard as repeated pressure before the focus claim.
The focus's causative ending allows the wealth-buffer to be imagined as producing the subject's immovability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies squeezing, prodding, pushing, cushioning, and clinging; I infer a counterforce relation in which wealth buffers the aggressor and transmits pressure outward. The alternative is a purely verbal-social reading with no material pressure analogy.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is a general comfort that makes him feel secure.
changed_reading.after: Wealth is imagined as a pressure-buffer: it seats him firmly enough to push others and mistake protected position for permanence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering turns scattered assets into one inventory, repeated enumeration stabilizes that inventory as a mental total, and the focus's reckoning projects the total into enduring time.

activation_trace.role: The accounting branch anchors the mental conversion from inventory to predicted duration.
The enduring-state branch supplies the temporal result wrongly inferred from the total.
The gathering branch supplies the first operation, consolidating scattered items into a countable whole.
The wealth branch identifies what is consolidated and measured.
The enumeration branch makes counting an explicit repeated practice rather than a hidden metaphor.
The recurring-time branch supplies the bridge by which repeated totals can masquerade as renewed time.

structural_cues: The immediately preceding sequence moves from consolidation to wealth to intensive enumeration.
The focus then begins with another reckoning term, creating an accounting echo across the ayah boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, wealth, enumeration, recurring time, and enduring duration; I infer that the subject transfers numerical increase into temporal increase. The alternative is that counting merely characterizes hoarding and has no cognitive role in the permanence claim.

changed_reading.before: He has much wealth and therefore feels generally safe.
changed_reading.after: Each recounting rehearses a false equation: a larger, repeatedly refreshed total is treated as a longer, repeatedly refreshed life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hoard is not only gathered; latent fist and fetter images make gathering constrictive. Prepared stock then binds the possessor to maintenance of the stock, activating permanence as clinging rather than freedom from death.

activation_trace.role: The property branch anchors the possessive relation that will be reversed.
The clinging branch allows the supposed gift of permanence to become attachment and inability to leave.
The clenched-hand branch materializes accumulation as a grip rather than neutral collection.
The fetter branch supplies the reversal in which what is brought together also binds.
The repeated wealth branch makes the bond specifically a relation to accumulated property.
The prepared-stock branch adds vigilance and provisioning that keep the possessor servicing the hoard.

structural_cues: The object pronoun on the counting verb closes the action back upon the gathered wealth.
The possessive form in the focus says it is his wealth, while the causative predicate lets that possession act back upon him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grasping, fettering, prepared stock, possession, and clinging; I infer a reversal from owning the hoard to being held by it. The alternative is that the constraint images are remote branches and gathering remains simple acquisition.

changed_reading.before: He owns wealth that will keep him alive.
changed_reading.after: The wealth owns his attention and fixes him to itself; what he calls immortality is the hoard's grip on its keeper.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rare branch-to-branch echo reverses the focus's imagined support: the cushion that props the subject is answered by a cushion cast aside, and the destination then breaks what seemed securely seated.

strongest_changes: The preceding gathering and repeated counting make the focus's reckoning a precise conversion of property quantity into imagined personal duration.
Clenched, fettering, and sealed-store images reverse possession: the hoard that should preserve its owner instead binds and encloses him.
The rare cushion branch in the focus is answered by the next ayah's discarded-cushion branch, turning wealth from prop into cast-off support.
The later inward inspection strengthens a psychological reading in which wealth makes the immortality-belief, rather than the body, persist in the heart.
Final support and extension imagery mirrors the original fantasy in hostile form: permanence becomes prolonged, compulsory confinement.
summary.what_was_special: The trace is driven by branch collisions rather than a single resolved interpretation: counting meets recurring time, prop meets discarded cushion, settled thought meets inward ignition, and a split closure root yields both sealing and a stone store for wealth. These activations preserve causal, social, material, psychological, and carceral readings side by side.
remaining_uncertainties: The arrows from social disparagement to rank maintenance and from hoarded wealth to fuel are reader-supplied mechanisms, not explicit packet assertions.
The cushioning, spider, blind-creature, and profuse-outflow activations are deliberately form-distant and should remain exploratory.
The final extension may be only spatial rather than temporal, so the ironic prolonged-abiding reading remains coexistent with an architectural reading.
The non-dominant stone wealth-store branch strongly activates the vault reversal, but closure need not historically or compositionally depend on that branch.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Accounting becomes false permanence.** Evidence: `ح س ب B001` (counting/reckoning), `ح س ب B002` (supposition), `م و ل B001`, and `خ ل د B001` (enduring permanence); activated backward by `ع د د B001` in 104:2. Structural cue: enumeration immediately produces a mental claim about دوام. Assigned role: حساب is the bridge from arithmetic to belief. Abductive move: repeated counting trains the self to experience quantity as ontological security. Reading change: the ayah shows how the thought of wealth-made permanence is manufactured by counting.

2. **Clinging to wealth becomes sealed permanence.** Evidence: `خ ل د B002` (leaning, clinging, staying close), activated by `و ص د B001` in 104:8 and `م د د B004` in 104:9. Structural cue: the imagined "made him endure" is later answered by a shut, extended condition. Assigned role: خلود supplies both desired permanence and adhesive attachment. Abductive move: punishment converts chosen clinging into inescapable clinging imposed on him. Reading change: the error is not abstract belief in immortality only; it is a posture of sticking to wealth that is reversed into confinement.

3. **The false thought lodged in the heart.** Evidence: `خ ل د B004` (settled thought in the heart) and `ح س ب B002`, activated by `ف ء د B002` and `ط ل ع B003` in 104:7. Structural cue: a mental verb in 104:3 is later met by fire that reaches the أفئدة. Assigned role: خلد names the inner settling-place of the delusion. Abductive move: if the fire reaches the heart, it reaches the place where false حساب has settled. Reading change: 104:3 becomes the interior target of the later fire, not merely a report of wrong opinion.

4. **Wealth as imagined sufficiency.** Evidence: `ح س ب B003` (sufficiency/enoughness) with `م و ل B001`, activated by the mercy frame of 104:0 and divine fire in 104:6. Structural cue: the possessive ماله places wealth as his supposed sufficient resource. Assigned role: حسب supplies the "enough for me" claim beneath the thought. Abductive move: possession is mistaken for what suffices before God and society. Reading change: the ayah exposes self-sufficiency as the root of the immortalizing fantasy.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 104:7 caused the sharpest change: يحسب is not left in the head but is relocated into the فؤاد as an inward heat/kindling. 104:8-9 then turned "أخلده" into irony: the permanence he imagined appears, but as sealed duration and extension rather than life-giving endurance.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Calculation collapsing into supposition.** Fixed `يَحْسَبُ` holds together `ح س ب B001` (counting and reckoning) and `ح س ب B002` (mental supposition); fixed `مَالَهُ` is `م و ل B001`, and fixed `أَخْلَدَهُ` activates `خ ل د B001` (making something endure). The immediately preceding `عَدَّدَهُ`, `ع د د B001`, supplies the numerical input. The packet gives counting followed by supposition; I infer that the former licenses the latter. The ayah now diagnoses a category error in which a finite count is treated as proof of unbounded duration.

2. **Wealth imagined as sufficient against change.** Fixed `يَحْسَبُ` also activates `ح س ب B003` (sufficiency and enoughness) in proximity to fixed wealth, `م و ل B001`, and fixed permanence, `خ ل د B001`. `104:4`-`104:6` then supply casting, breaking, and kindling, all processes that wealth fails to stop. The packet supplies the claimed cause and its material defeat; I infer that the suppressed premise is "my wealth is enough." The reading changes from a mistaken forecast to a claim of self-sufficiency against transformation and judgment.

3. **Permanence as an inwardly settled thought.** Fixed `أَخْلَدَهُ` activates `خ ل د B004`, a thought settled in the heart, when `104:7` names the inner-kindling heart through `ف ء د B002` and says the fire rises upon it through `ط ل ع B003` (overlooking and disclosing an interior). The packet supplies the belief and the later heart-directed disclosure; I infer that what the fire exposes is the permanence-calculus lodged inwardly. The ayah consequently reads not only as an erroneous proposition but as a settled interior orientation that the later fire reaches.

4. **A reversal from chosen clinging to imposed staying.** Fixed `أَخْلَدَهُ` further activates `خ ل د B002` (clinging, settling, and remaining close). `104:4` casts the subject away, while `104:8` seals the fire over them with `و ص د B001`. Those spatial facts are supplied; I infer the reversal linking them: attachment to wealth does not secure free continuity but culminates in immobilized continuity inside closure. The causative phrase can therefore read as wealth training its owner to cling, a habit whose promised permanence returns as confinement.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `104:7` was the decisive lexical surprise: `ف ء د B002` made `خ ل د B004`, settled thought in the heart, directly functional rather than merely associative. `104:8` then corrected a purely temporal reading of permanence by adding sealed spatial arrest. Together they preserve two distinct activations of the fixed causative: wealth settles a permanence-belief inwardly, and chosen clinging is reversed into imposed staying.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Gathered quantities are counted, provisioned, extended, and treated as though numerical control could secure adequacy or duration.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Quantity expands into total capacity, reserve logistics, calendrical spans, devotional fixation on property, and the return of worldly goods to breakable debris.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hoarding, Calculation, and False Permanence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Property is gathered and repeatedly counted, then mentally promoted from a reserve into a guarantor of lasting existence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gathering dispersed holdings (`ج م ع:B001/m01`); numerical enumeration (`ع د د:B001/m01`); accumulated property (`م و ل:B001/m01`); accounting and calculation (`ح س ب:B001/m01`); supposition (`ح س ب:B002/m01`); enduring permanence (`خ ل د:B001/m01`); devotion and object-making (`ء ل ه:B001/m01`); transient worldly goods (`ح ط م:B009/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 104:2 جَمَعَ (`ج م ع`), مَالًا (`م و ل`), and عَدَّدَهُ (`ع د د`); 104:3 يَحْسَبُ (`ح س ب`), مَالَهُ (`م و ل`), and أَخْلَدَهُ (`خ ل د`); 104:4-5 ٱلْحُطَمَةِ/ٱلْحُطَمَةُ (`ح ط م`); 104:6 ٱللَّهِ (`ء ل ه`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Counting converts possessions into an apparently closed system of security. The devotional branch sharpens the relation: wealth can be treated as an object of ultimate reliance, yet the crushing branch recasts its display and ornament as passing debris.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Gathered quantities are counted, provisioned, extended, and treated as though numerical control could secure adequacy or duration.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Quantity expands into total capacity, reserve logistics, calendrical spans, devotional fixation on property, and the return of worldly goods to breakable debris.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Prepared Reserves and Material Aid
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Supplies are measured, stored, and made ready so they can sustain a person, household, or force when need arrives.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prepared equipment and reserves (`ع د د:B002/m01`); reinforcements and material aid (`م د د:B002/m01`); sufficient provision (`ح س ب:B003/m01`); measured allotment (`م د د:B006/m01`); small residual portion (`ن ب ذ:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Enumeration becomes logistics: one prepares an outfit, reserve, weapon, food supply, or reinforcement, then portions it by measure. The tiny remainder and the sufficient store establish the lower and upper bounds of usable provision.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material is fed into heat, transformed by combustion or digestion, and carried from an external fire into bodily and emotional interiors.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The fire scene includes fuel, hearth, cooking vessel, digestive action, inward anger, appetite, vomiting, summer heat, and drought.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Heart as an Interior Fire
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Thought lodges in the heart, heat gathers there, and rapid ignition becomes ardor, anger, or social conflict.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: heart as inward heat (`ف ء د:B002/m01`); thought lodged in the mind or heart (`خ ل د:B004/m01`); emotional ardor, anger, or war (`و ق د:B005/m02`); anger's domination (`ع م د:B015/m01`); feud between groups (`ن و ر:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The heart is not merely reached by fire; it already has a lexical capacity for inner burning. A settled thought can kindle into fervor, anger, and conflict, so psychological fixation and social hostility reproduce the dynamics of combustion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Individuals become a durable social body through assembly, alliance, rank, kinship, and reproductive connection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Collective cohesion ranges from public assembly and strategic alliance to tent-based status, collateral inheritance, sexual union, pregnancy, and the suspended state of an unconsummated marriage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Tent Community and Comparative Standing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A mobile tent community distinguishes households and persons by inherited standing, visible qualities, and comparison with peers.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: socially counted prestige (`ح س ب:B004/m01`); people of tents and poles (`ع م د:B004/m01`); peer, counterpart, or allotted share (`ع د د:B006/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The tent pole supplies a social setting as well as a structure. Within it, standing is something reckoned from ancestry, conduct, generosity, or wealth and negotiated by comparison with others.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Individuals become a durable social body through assembly, alliance, rank, kinship, and reproductive connection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Collective cohesion ranges from public assembly and strategic alliance to tent-based status, collateral inheritance, sexual union, pregnancy, and the suspended state of an unconsummated marriage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Collateral Kin and Inherited Standing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A death activates lateral kinship, and inherited standing identifies which relations count when direct parent-child continuity is absent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: collateral kin and inheritance (`ك ل ل:B004/m01`); ancestral standing (`ح س ب:B004/m02`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Social accounting reaches into genealogy. When the direct line is missing, lateral relations become operative, while ancestry supplies the remembered standing through which the family locates itself.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Knowledge is sought or assembled, converted into intention, and then directed toward governance, reconnaissance, hunting, conflict, or formal exchange.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Epistemic inquiry develops into administrative oversight, scouting, a concealed hunt, projectile mechanics, treaty renunciation, and sale by thrown token.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Knowing, Testing, and Disclosure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An unknown matter is investigated, tested, learned, and disclosed to another observer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: knowing a matter (`د ر ي:B001/m01`); informing another (`د ر ي:B001/m02`); seeking and testing news (`ح س ب:B010/m01`); inspecting or revealing hidden affairs (`ط ل ع:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Inquiry moves from uncertain report to tested knowledge, then from private discovery to disclosure. Looking into a hidden matter and causing another to know it are consecutive roles in one epistemic process.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Knowledge is sought or assembled, converted into intention, and then directed toward governance, reconnaissance, hunting, conflict, or formal exchange.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Epistemic inquiry develops into administrative oversight, scouting, a concealed hunt, projectile mechanics, treaty renunciation, and sale by thrown token.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Deliberation and Accountable Leadership
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A group consolidates its judgment, an overseer examines conduct, and a relied-upon leader carries the decision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: resolved collective judgment (`ج م ع:B003/m01`); practical oversight and accountability (`ح س ب:B006/m01`); relied-upon leader (`ع م د:B006/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Distributed opinions are gathered into resolve, oversight tests the resulting conduct, and leadership supplies the person on whom implementation rests. Cognition becomes administration.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies move between intact strength and loss of integrity through pain, heart disease, aging, pressure wounds, suppuration, or altered skin.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The body appears as chest and heart, aged mount, swollen saddle wound, vigorous youth, intact animal, and skin whose color shades into disease.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mottled Color and Skin Affliction
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: White, red, gray, or patchy coloration becomes a visible bodily state and may shade into a skin disorder.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: mottled skin or hair coloration (`ح س ب:B009/m01`); disease-like discoloration (`ح س ب:B009/m02`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Reckoning shifts into visible pattern: colors are distributed across skin, hair, or hide, and the same appearance can be read as ordinary coloration or bodily affliction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A visible surface is dressed, encircled, groomed, colored, marked, or made to flash.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Presentation includes a child's undergarment, earrings and bracelets, combing, kohl, depilation, tattoo smoke, livestock branding, crowns, smiles, and gemstone-like sparkle.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Garment and Attached Jewelry
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Clothing covers the body while ornaments remain attached at the ear or wrist as durable visible additions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: small undergarment (`ء ص د:B003/m01`); attached earrings or bracelets (`خ ل د:B003/m01`); garments gathered over the body (`ج م ع:B009/m02`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 104:2 جَمَعَ (`ج م ع`); 104:3 أَخْلَدَهُ (`خ ل د`); no separate surface occurrence for `ء ص د`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Covering and attachment form two layers of presentation. Garments gather around the body, while jewelry remains fixed to selected points and turns persistence into ornament.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Persons and objects are positioned by clinging to a place, moving aside, or being cast beyond a social or spatial center.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Spatial placement becomes a social relation encompassing residence, withdrawal, foundlings, dependents, and neglected animals.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Clinging and Continued Residence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person adheres to a place or companion, settles there, and remains.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: clinging, resting, or dwelling (`خ ل د:B002/m01`); continued adherence or residence (`ع م د:B014/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Attachment is both relational and spatial. One leans toward a person or place, then converts that inclination into sustained residence.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek bir ihtiyacı karşılayacak ölçüye ulaşmaktır; bol armağan yalnızca belirtilen verme kuruluşlarında bu çekirdeği aşar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü örümceğe verilen bir ad olarak aktarır, fakat aynı ifadenin içinde bu aktarımın kuşkuyla karşılandığını ve güvenilir bir aktarıcıdan işitilmediğini de açıkça bildirir. concept_gloss.applicability: Körlük veya gözlerin bulunmaması ile fare ya da sıçan benzerliğinin birlikte korunduğu genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Gözsüzlük, küçük hayvan oluşu ve fare ya da sıçan benzerliğini birlikte taşır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın sıçanlar içinde bir tür ve görme yetisinden yoksun olarak anlatıldığı bağlama uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sıçan türü olma ile körlük özelliklerini eksiksiz biçimde korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gözleri olmayan, fareye veya sıçana benzeyen küçük hayvan

error_profile.preserves: Kör ve faremsi küçük yer hayvanı görünümünü kısmen çağrıştırır.
error_profile.loses: Tanıklığın fare ve sıçan alanındaki açık sınıflandırmasını kesin olarak göstermez.
error_profile.adds: Belirli bir çağdaş hayvan türü ve onun kazma davranışı gibi kanıtlanmamış özellikler getirir.
error_profile.collision: Açıklamayı kanıtın vermediği kesin bir tür adı sanılmasına yol açar.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın fareye benzeyen görünüşünü ve küçük oluşunu taşır.
error_profile.loses: Körlük veya gözlerin hiç bulunmaması biçimindeki ayırıcı özelliği kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Gören farelerin tamamını da kapsayan çok daha geniş bir hayvan alanı getirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, hayvanın kör ya da gözsüz ve fareye benzer olduğunu açıkça belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, körlük veya görünüş sınırı koymadan doğrudan bir sıçan adını verir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da sıçan ya da fare alanındaki küçük bir hayvanı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı sınırı körlük ve faremsi görünümdür; komşu dal bu nitelikleri zorunlu kılmadan yalnız sıçan adını bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, gözleri olmayan ya da görmeyen özel bir faremsi hayvanı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, körlük belirtmeden sıçanı veya erkek fareyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kör faremsi tür / sıçan ya da erkek fare
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Fare ve sıçan alanındaki hayvan adlandırması iki dalda doğrudan örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal körlüğü zorunlu ayırt edici özellik yapar; komşu dal cinsiyet ya da genel sıçan adı üzerinden sınıflar ve görme durumunu sınırlamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kör ve fareye ya da sıçana benzeyen tek bir küçük hayvan türünü sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, çeşitli küçük yer hayvanlarını topluca kapsayan geniş bir sınıf adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kör faremsi hayvan / küçük yer hayvanları
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yerde yaşayan küçük hayvanların genel alanında bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal körlük ve fare benzerliğiyle belirlenmiş tekil bir tür alanıdır; komşu dal kirpi ve başka küçük canlılara kadar uzanan toplu bir sınıftır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kör ve faremsi küçük bir hayvanı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, insanın akıl alanını, orada bulunan düşünceyi ve bir şeyin akla gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kör faremsi hayvan / akıl ve düşünce
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı çıplak biçim sözlük tanıklıklarında iki bağımsız anlamın adı olarak kullanılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal somut bir küçük hayvanı adlandırır; komşu dal ise bütünüyle zihinsel bir alan ve düşünce içeriğidir, aralarında anlam aktarımı yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, gözsüz ve fareye benzeyen küçük hayvanla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, varlığını uzun süre sürdürme ve aynı durumda kalma anlamını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki bağımsız anlam, aynı kökün ayrı sözlük dalları olarak yan yana bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir hayvan adıdır; komşu dal süreklilik ve korunmuş durum kavramıdır, ortak biçim dışında kavramsal örtüşme bulunmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: On iki adayın tümü değerlendirildi. Fare ve sıçan alanındaki iki en yakın komşu, geniş küçük yer hayvanları sınıfı ve aynı biçimi taşıyan iki kardeş dal seçildi; kalan hayvan adayları farklı türler veya yalnız uzak bir canlılık alanı sundu.

root_profile.summary: Kök, kalıcı olma ve durumunu korumadan yönelip bağlı kalmaya ve zihinde yer etmeye uzanan ilişkili anlamların yanında küpeyle süslenme ile kör faremsi küçük hayvan adlarını da taşır. Beş dal, kısmen süreklilik ve yerleşme çevresinde bağlanan, kısmen de bağımsız adlandırmalardan oluşan çok anlamlı bir yapı kurar.

concept_gloss.text: kalıcı var oluş ve durumunu koruma
bir hedefe bağlanıp ona yapışma ya da ondan ayrılmama
küpe; küpe ya da bilezik takmış olma
akıl ve akılda yer eden düşünce
